name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Did you come to hear about another urban legend?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, yes. Wow, how did you know?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You feel somewhat different from before. I'm glad you've reclaimed your memories."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. But... the most important part is still hazy."

name: Shiori
message: "So I'm walking around town to sort through my memories, and to say thank you to the people who've helped me until now."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I haven't done anything to warrant your thanks. It was an equal exchange, remember?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...I hope you remember the important part too."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, I should probably explain how I died, shouldn't I?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If an urban legend is involved, then yes."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry to disappoint, but it has nothing to do with that."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You should leave. This is cursed ground. One who has reclaimed her light does not belong here."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. Well then... goodbye, Kashima Reiko-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... we should've told her about the little thought-form."

name: Shiori
message: "She's practically an urban legend aberration. Kashima Reiko-san would've loved that."

name: Shiori
message: "But probably not enough to justify going back just to tell her."

name: Shiori
message: "If you get the chance, you can tell her instead. She'd probably be thrilled."

name: Shiori
message: "Now then, shall we head to our next stop?"
